outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs; it is not a plot and carries no significance symbols.

The bar/scatter plot displays a single asterisk (*) above the comparison bracket to denote significance, but neither the image nor the caption defines what this symbol represents (e.g., a threshold such as P < 0.05). The caption only states the exact P value (P = 0.0281) and the test used (unpaired t test with Welch's correction), but does not state the significance-level convention corresponding to the asterisk.
Panel C consists of histology/fluorescence/RNAscope images and spatial expression heatmaps; there are no statistical significance symbols present.
The GSEA enrichment plots report exact NES, FDR, and p values directly on each panel rather than using significance symbols (e.g., asterisks), so no symbol definition is required.
The bar graph reports exact P values above each bar rather than using significance symbols, so there is nothing requiring a symbol definition.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images; it is not a plot and contains no significance symbols.
